label: The Muse
terms_note: Public Jobs API v2 (optional api_key raises the rate limit). Apply links go to the employer.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (public Jobs API v2, apply off-platform).
auth: 1. No key needed for testing (500 requests/hour).
2. Register the app at /developers/api/v2 → `api_key`, passed as a query parameter → 3,600 requests/hour and change notifications.

endpoints.notes: `page` (required, 20 per page; response `page`, `page_count`, `results`), `category`, `level`, `location`, `company`, `descending`; each job: id, name, contents (HTML), publication_date, locations[], categories[], levels[], company{id,name,short_name}, refs.landing_page
same object as the list entry

reference.limits: 500 requests/hour without a key, 3,600/hour with a registered `api_key`; `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers; 403 when exceeded. - API Terms (3.3 – 3.4): do not replicate Muse products, sublicense / redistribute the API or Platform, circumvent protections, or clone Muse content; content shown must link back to themuse.com; respect the rate limits (4.2). - Nothing in the API touches a job seeker's account — no automated-application clause needed.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Optional: register the app at https://www.themuse.com/developers/api/v2 to get an api_key (sent as the api_key query parameter), raising the limit from 500 to 3,600 requests/hour.

me.note: Verified with a one-page jobs request (The Muse has no account endpoint; works without a key at the lower rate limit).

search.note: No keyword parameter is documented (filters are category, level, location, company), so query is not sent — filter client-side. page is required and pages hold 20 results (do not pass limit). Rate limit 500 requests/hour without a key, 3,600 with one (X-RateLimit-* headers); the platform answers 403 when exceeded, which surfaces here as auth_error. Content shown must link back to themuse.com.

get_posting.note: Same object as a search hit.

not_offered.apply: Page: 'not offered — refs.landing_page leads to The Muse job page, then the employer'.

evidence: probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 403 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 3/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
live read without credentials: search returned data that validates against the vocabulary
